info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Quote Management API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Quote Management API enables users to efficiently update existing quotes in the wholesale trading environment. This API provides the necessary operations to modify quote details, ensuring that pricing and terms remain current and accurate. Typical consumers include trading platforms and financial institutions that require real-time quote adjustments for market responsiveness. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their trading strategies and optimize client interactions without extensive manual intervention.

patch.summary: Update Quote Management for Wholesale Trading
patch.description: This operation allows users to update the details of a specific quote management entry identified by RES-100045 within the wholesale trading system. It enables modifications to various attributes of the quote, enhancing the management capabilities of trading quotes.
